name: hud_layout_hw_set_active
description: HudLayoutHW::SetActive applies the hardware HUD viewport, assigns hardware widget blit sources on activation, submits the software occlusion rect when needed, and clears HUD blit sources on deactivation.
known_limits: Tier C first; no VC verification target currently covers 0x4130d0, so tier S acceptance remains deferred to a HUD layout source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4130d0 validate the acceleration-option reset, activeRect primary-width/origin update, HudLayout::ApplyViewportRect call, inactive HUD source clearing loop over all 10 messages, clear-screen exchange/call/restore sequence, active OnActivated dispatch, widget1 assignment to objective counter/timer panels, widget2 assignment to message indices 1 through 9 and the nanite panel, zClipAlt source update, and software-acceleration occluder submission with reciprocal near clip.

Direct callees in the functional frontier are reconstructed, dependency-ready, implemented, and functionally accepted, including HudLayout::ApplyViewportRect, HudUiElement::SetBltSourceAndClipRect, zClipAlt::SetSourceRect, zClass_Camera::gwCameraGetNearFarClip, zOpt::GetReplicateMode, zRndr::SpanOcclusionResetFrame, zRndr::SpanOcclusionSubmitOccluderRect, and zVideo clear dispatch helpers.

The native hardware layout set-active smoke installs concrete HUD panel/message objects plus option/camera/video globals, calls SetActive(1), and verifies OnActivated dispatch, widget image assignment, skipped message slot 0 on activation, zClipAlt source state, and the submitted sensor occluder polygon. It then calls SetActive(0) and verifies all relevant HUD blit sources are cleared, span occlusion is reset, and the clear-screen buffer state is restored after the primary clear call.
